concept: Asking 'why' is how we learn — questions are not rude, they're powerful
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Socratic-questioning tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a curious character keeps asking 'why' about something everyone else takes for granted, and discovers something surprising
exercise.reflection_prompt: What is something you've always wondered 'why' about?
exercise.practice: Student asks the mentor persona three 'why' questions about anything they're curious about

assessment.success_marker: student generates at least one genuine question of their own, not just answering the mentor's prompts
